channel.title: Equatorial Guinea - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Equatorial Guinea, every source cited.

item.title: Equatorial Guinean goalkeeper injures opponent
item.description: Jesús Lázaro Owono's collision with Jesús de Miguel during a Spanish Segunda División match caused immediate concern.

item.title: Police arrest man for attempted cathedral fire
item.description: Severo Oburu Ekong Afang, 54, is accused of trying to set fire to Malabo Cathedral after his warnings were ignored.

item.title: Fire destroys eight homes in Malabo
item.description: Over 10 families lost all belongings after a short circuit sparked a blaze in the Héroe Luba neighbourhood.
